purpose: Provide a consistent, evidence-based work sequence for every canonical revenue lane, while keeping lane-specific detailed guides, current source research, legal review and demonstrated results as separate requirements.
truth_boundary: A framework is not a completed course, a verified opportunity, a live offer, a sale, or revenue. All estimates remain estimates until reconciled to verified events.
global_rules: Use current authorized sources and record provenance
Separate discovery from eligibility and execution
No professional legal, tax, investment, insurance or real-estate advice beyond permitted education and qualified human review
No external actions without user/owner approval
No payment, spending, payout, or live monetization without the existing live revenue gate
Measure outcomes using verified evidence only

shared_stages.title: Discover the problem and demand
tasks: Define target user and problem
Collect current evidence of demand from authorized sources
Record source URLs, access dates, and confidence
Separate facts, estimates, and assumptions

shared_stages.title: Qualify the opportunity
tasks: Check geography, eligibility, timing, and provider terms
Identify prerequisites, licensing, and required registrations
Check conflicts, fraud signals, and disqualifiers
Record human-review requirements

shared_stages.title: Model costs and unit economics
tasks: Estimate setup and recurring costs
Include fees, taxes, shipping, labor, refunds, and support
Calculate break-even and downside scenarios
Show assumptions and uncertainty; never guarantee returns

shared_stages.title: Design the offer and fulfillment
tasks: Define deliverable, scope, and exclusions
Set pricing and customer terms
Document fulfillment, support, cancellation, and refund paths
Confirm capacity and partner responsibilities

shared_stages.title: Prepare an approved experiment
tasks: Define a small measurable experiment
Set budget and outreach permissions separately
Prepare truthful copy and required disclosures
Require owner approval before publishing, spending, submitting, or contacting

shared_stages.title: Measure and improve
tasks: Track qualified demand, conversion, cost, delivery, refunds, and complaints
Reconcile money only from verified provider events
Compare results with the original hypothesis
Preserve failed attempts and update the playbook

Include fees, taxes, shipping, labor, refunds, and support
Calculate break-even and downside scenarios
Show assumptions and uncertainty; never guarantee returns

stages.title: Design the offer and fulfillment
tasks: Define deliverable, scope, and exclusions
Set pricing and customer terms
Document fulfillment, support, cancellation, and refund paths
Confirm capacity and partner responsibilities

stages.title: Prepare an approved experiment
tasks: Define a small measurable experiment
Set budget and outreach permissions separately
Prepare truthful copy and required disclosures
Require owner approval before publishing, spending, submitting, or contacting

stages.title: Measure and improve
tasks: Track qualified demand, conversion, cost, delivery, refunds, and complaints
Reconcile money only from verified provider events
Compare results with the original hypothesis
Preserve failed attempts and update the playbook
